text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S ran with all her might in 
the Arima Kinen. The crowd acknowledged 
her skill, and began to look upon her 
brusque nature with fondness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion and Tap Dance City were 
inspired by Symboli Kris S's running. Both 
resolved to aim for even greater heights 
of passion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S and her Trainer think about 
demonstrating absolute strength next time. 
That should leave a new impact on the 
racing world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With their final Classic Year battle 
concluded, the two began moving forward 
onto a brand-new stage.
